data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate strengthened prior year reserves by $2.6m during 2016 (2015: release of $2.9m).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a strengthening of prior year reserves of $2.6m in 2016 (2015: release $2.9m). This represents an adverse prior-year reserve movement of approximately 0.8% of opening gross claims outstanding (opening = 327.6). The report does not quantify gross prior-year movements by specific event or underwriting year.
raw_causal_phrases: The syndicate strengthened prior year reserves by $2.6m during 2016 (2015: release of $2.9m).
The syndicate's overall claims ratio increased from 59% in the prior year to 62% in 2016.
Our life, accident and health segment made a loss in the year, driven primarily by our Australian business.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding 327.6 as at 1 Jan 2016). Prior year development amount ($2.6m) taken from Managing Agent strategic narrative which states 'strengthened prior year reserves by $2.6m' - the report does not explicitly state whether this figure is gross or net; it is recorded here as reported (assumed gross for purposes of this extraction). A gross claims development triangle is present in the notes but the detailed development-period cumulative numeric matrix for each development lag was not extractable in full for automated diagonal calculation; therefore the narrative figure was used as primary source.
